events.title: Tupac Shakur's legacy
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, influential American rapper and actor Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in Las Vegas, Nevada, at the age of 25.

angles.name: Remembering Tupac
angles.copy: Thirty years ago today, the music world lost a true icon. Remembering Tupac Shakur, whose powerful lyrics and undeniable talent continue to resonate. What's your go-to track?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's legacy
events.blurb: On this day in 1970, American rock guitarist, singer, and composer Jimi Hendrix passed away at the age of 27 in London, England.

angles.name: Guitar Legend Remembered
angles.copy: The man who redefined the electric guitar. Remembering Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84, and his unparalleled genius today. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: Abbey Road anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road at 57
angles.copy: Still crossing that road 57 years later! The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' was released today. Which track takes you straight to the studio?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: American-British singer-songwriter Chrissie Hynde, best known as the frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: A true rock icon! Wishing Chrissie Hynde of The Pretenders a very happy 75th birthday. What's your favourite Pretenders anthem?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Liam Gallagher, known as the former frontman of Oasis and Beady Eye, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam Gallagher
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54 today! Wishing a very happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

events.title: Imagine album anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his seminal album 'Imagine' on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine at 55
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A timeless message that resonates just as strongly today. What does the song mean to you?

events.title: iPod anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the very first iPod, revolutionising portable music, on this day in 2001.

angles.name: Remember the first iPod?
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago today, Apple dropped the original iPod and changed how we listen to music forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated annually as James Bond Day, marking the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Happy James Bond Day
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred. Happy James Bond Day! Who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate 007 theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon, who passed away in 1980, would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the visionary John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, screenwriter, and Monty Python co-founder John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true British comedy icon. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: White Album anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album at 58
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered the sprawling masterpiece that is 'The White Album'. Which track from the double LP is your absolute favourite?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's legacy
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, the incomparable Freddie Mercury, lead vocalist of Queen, passed away at the age of 45.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie Mercury
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago, the world lost a voice like no other. Remembering the legend, Freddie Mercury, whose stage presence and vocal power remain unmatched.

events.title: Rubber Soul anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul at 61
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles released the seminal 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that saw them evolve their sound. What's your top track?

events.title: John Lennon's legacy
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, musician, songwriter, and activist John Lennon was tragically killed in New York City at the age of 40.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, we lost a legend. Remembering John Lennon and his enduring impact on music and the world. His message of peace lives on.
